name: Meiwa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Meiwa town emblem in blue: a ring overlapping a smaller ring, like a crescent.
history: Municipal flag of Meiwa, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 August 1960.

features.role: Meiwa town emblem — a ring overlapping a smaller ring, like a crescent
